system.description: Just as the cold wind sweeps out from above the warmer, rising air, the master of Night Breeze Style flows beneath and away from oncoming ranged attacks. As part of a dodge, the Exalt leaps backward a distance of up to (Martial Arts) yards. By spending additional Essence, she can leap farther. Each additional mote adds a number of yards equal to her Martial Arts to her leap. She cannot leap farther than (her Essence x Martial Arts) yards. If this movement takes the martial artist out of her attacker's current range increment (not necessarily completely out of range), the attack automatically misses. This Charm does not affect perfect attacks or ranged attacks that suffer no penalties for range.
